name: What's the best way to clean different types of siding?

mainEntity.name: What's the best way to clean different types of siding?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best cleaning method depends on your siding material. For vinyl, fiber cement, and aluminum, a soft-bristle brush, garden hose, and a mild detergent (like dish soap or specialized siding cleaner) are usually effective. Power washing can be used, but with caution; use a wide spray nozzle and low pressure (below 1500 PSI) to avoid damaging the material or forcing water behind the panels. Wood siding requires a more gentle approach to prevent moisture damage; use a soft brush and wood-safe cleaner. Always test cleaning solutions on an inconspicuous area first.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use a soft brush and mild detergent for most siding types. Power washing requires caution, especially for vinyl and wood siding. Always test cleaners first.
